metadata.description:
Case name: Tuggle v. Netherland

Opinion filed: 1995-10-30

Docket No.: 95-6016

Citations:
• 133 L. Ed. 2d 251
• 116 S. Ct. 283
• 516 U.S. 10
• 1995 U.S. LEXIS 7154

Case holding summaries:
• "[W]e held in Ake [ ], that when a prosecutor presents psychiatric evidence of an indigent defendant's future dangerousness in a capital sentencing proceeding, due process requires that the State provide the defendant with the assistance of an independent psychiatrist"
• remanding for determination whether harmless-error analysis applied
• clarifying that this rule does not permit affirmance in cases where the constitutional taint of the illegitimate factor infects the other factors
